Name: Birsha
Summary: Birsha was the king of Gomorrah who joined Sodom's rebellion against Chedorlaomer and was defeated with him.
KeyStory: Birsha's city fell with Sodom's in the Valley of Siddim, and its people were carried off until Abram's rescue.
LifeLesson: Empires rise and fall, but God's promise to Abram outlasted every king of his day.
